reader.requirement: At 85 (level 2) a CLOSE or CLOSE WITH LOCK of an OPTIONAL indexed input file that was not present performs no end-of-file processing (no file is created or written), leaves the file position indicator unchanged and completes successfully ('00').

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.CloseWithLockRemoved2023: CLOSE WITH LOCK accepted at 85/2002/2014, refused COBOL0902 at 2023
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector (from 2002): at 85 the lock is set on the physical file's state, from 2002 on the connector
the same behavior, the OPEN-side test of that lock ('38')

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehaviors./Edition/CobolVersion in FileRegistry.cs, FileConnector.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, IndexedConnector.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs#EmitClose and VersionConformancePass.cs: the plain CLOSE path (SequentialIoEmitter#EmitClose -> FileRegistry#CloseByFormat/#CloseCell -> FileConnector#Close -> KeyedConnector#CloseCore) consults no edition; only the WITH LOCK arm does.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb140_close_status's OPTIONAL file is sequential; no witness closes an absent optional INDEXED file

probes.printed: OPT-OPEN=05 OPT-EOF OPT-READ=10 OPT-CLOSE=00 OPT-REOPEN=05 OPT-START=23 OPT-LOCK=00 OPT-AFTERLOCK=38; no close2-absent.dat exists after the run
probes.expected: '00' on CLOSE; the file stays absent (no end-of-file processing creates it); a reopen is again '05'

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.2.4 GR4  (4.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: KeyedConnector#CloseCore skips the store promotion when OptionalAbsent and leaves that FPI state untouched. After the CLOSE the FPI is not observable, so the probe witnesses the absence of end-of-file processing and the successful status.

refuter.evidence: cite.py OK §1985:IX.4.2.4 GR4. E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-007/cls1.cob --std 85: SELECT OPTIONAL ... ACCESS SEQUENTIAL over an absent file: IO-OPEN=05, IO-CLOSE-LOCK=00, and no cls1-absent.dat exists after the run (ls shows only cls1-i.dat): no end-of-file processing created the file; the WITH LOCK lock still applies (IP-OPEN-OTHER-NAME=38), consistent with GR2's table where CLOSE WITH LOCK is A,B. FPI after CLOSE is unobservable.
